lines.en: label yasuspring3:
scene yasubenchlamp1
Sometime after something, the three of us begin to walk.
lines.zh: 某件事之后的某个时候，我们三个人开始走。

lines.en: It’s a dark night. A cold night. And we can not rely on the lamps lining our path to provide either a sufficient amount of light or any warmth at all because such convenience would be too much for us.
lines.zh: 这是个漆黑的夜。寒冷的夜。我们不能指望沿路的灯给足我们光，或者哪怕一丁点温暖——因为那样的便利，对我们来说太多了。

lines.en: But it’s fine if we are undeserving — because those who shunned Zachariel (the first) were God’s children as well and they were undeserving.
lines.zh: 但就算我们不配也没关系——因为那些摒弃 Zachariel（初代）的人同样是神的孩子，他们同样不配。

lines.en: They were meant to die.
lines.zh: 他们注定要死。

lines.en: Which makes me, a devout follower of streetlights, destined for that same trajectory in accepting a death that is both sure to come and overwhelmingly deserved.
lines.zh: 所以身为路灯的虔诚信徒的我，注定要走同一条轨迹，去接受一个既必定到来、又完全应得的死亡。

lines.en: But this is why it’s fine to be undeserving — because you can always deserve something else.
lines.zh: 但这正是不配也没关系的原因——因为你总还能配得上别的什么。

lines.en: Footstep after footstep, I hear us getting closer to the end of night. Not just the night, but night as a whole. Night as an idea. Night as a single shingle on a slanted rooftop that no one could ever sleep on.
lines.zh: 一步又一步，我听见我们正越来越接近夜的尽头。不只是这个夜晚，而是夜本身。作为概念的夜。作为斜屋顶上那块谁也睡不上去的瓦片的夜。

lines.en: I hope that we end up somewhere like that.
lines.zh: 我希望我们最终能到那样的地方。

lines.en: I hope that we all make it to the highest point of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 我希望我们都能抵达 Kumon-mi 的最高点。

lines.en: I am a strong boy.
lines.zh: 我是个强壮的男孩。

lines.en: It will take more than one set of arms to move me.
lines.zh: 想搬动我，一双胳膊可不够。

lines.en: : Is it just me, or have the two of you been rather off since leaving the cathedral?
lines.zh: : 只有我这么觉得吗？离开教堂之后，你们俩都有点不对劲。

lines.en: : To be off, one must first be on. And if there is anything I have learned about myself from the way those less enlightened view me, it’s that I am not fit to breathe their air.
lines.zh: : 要「不对劲」，得先「对劲」过才行。要说我从那些不那么开悟的人看我的眼神里学到了什么，那就是——我不配呼吸他们的空气。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp2
: Now now, Yasu. Self-deprecation is Sensei’s job, not yours.
lines.zh: : 好了好了，Yasu。自我贬低是 Sensei 的活儿，不是你的。

lines.en: : I think it’s safe to label us co-workers. Yasu’s been calling herself a worm since the day I met her pretty much.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们算同行比较准确。Yasu 从认识我的那天起，基本就在管自己叫虫子了。

lines.en: : It was right here, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 就是这里，对吧？

lines.en: scene sanabench13
: Was it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I remember it clearly — the voices swirling around the two of you as you sat there on that bench. The way my fingers trembled when I realized you had seen Him.
lines.zh: : 我记得很清楚——你们两个坐在那条长椅上时，声音就在你们周围打转。当我意识到你见过祂时，我的手指抖成了什么样。

lines.en: : Now, you see all sorts of things. But worry not, Sensei — for they’re all there just to trick you.
lines.zh: : 现在你什么都看得见了。不过别担心，Sensei——它们全在那儿，只为了骗你。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp3
: Your mind is a special one. That’s what He told me when we first met. That you’d be the key to a new creation.
lines.zh: : 你的心智很特别。我们第一次见面时祂就是这么告诉我的。说你会成为新造物的钥匙。

lines.en: : A sapling who steals the stars out of the sky and uses them to line his pockets.
lines.zh: : 一株把星星从天上偷下来、拿去衬自己口袋的树苗。

lines.en: : But when those pockets run dry and the blood of virgins has become too congealed to wet your wallet, you will come to seek new skin.
lines.zh: : 可等那些口袋空了，处女的血凝得再也浸不湿你的钱包时，你就会来寻找新的皮。

lines.en: : Not ceiling-water tea, nor a plate full of eggs — but skin. The kind you wear atop your own. Adorned with thorns and flowers alike. You’d be oh so beautiful.
lines.zh: : 不是天花板漏水泡的茶，也不是满满一盘蛋——是皮。套在你自己身上那种。荆棘与花一同点缀。你会美得不得了。

lines.en: : Yasu, your sermon has ended. There is no need to carry your leftover preachings out into the night with you.
lines.zh: : Yasu，你的布道已经结束了。没必要把剩下的说教带到夜里去。

lines.en: : The night is but a bridge from light to dark...which means that we are now in the realm of the abhorrent. And when threatened by those you can feel but not see, all that’s left to do is pray.
lines.zh: : 夜不过是从光通往暗的桥……也就是说，我们现在身处可憎之境。而被那些你能感觉到、却看不见的东西威胁时，剩下的就只有祈祷了。

lines.en: : Or ignore it.
lines.zh: : 或者无视它。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp4
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Both of those things have the same effect, don’t they? Apart from whatever psychological benefits some people manage to leech from the act of praying, I mean.
lines.zh: : 这两件事效果不是一样的吗？我是说，除了有些人能从祈祷这个动作里榨出点心理慰藉之外。

lines.en: : But for those of us who don’t believe, praying is just a more complicated way of ignoring things. Just...with a little more hope involved. But in the end, both actions lead you to the same place.
lines.zh: : 但对像我这样不信的人来说，祈祷只是一种更复杂的无视方式。只不过……多掺了点希望。可到头来，两种行为都把你带到同一个地方。

lines.en: : That’s where you are wrong, Sensei...praying does everything.
lines.zh: : 你错就错在这里了，Sensei……祈祷无所不能。

lines.en: : Does it? Because you pray almost constantly and you’re no better off now than you were when I met you.
lines.zh: : 是吗？你几乎无时无刻不在祈祷，可你现在的处境并不比我认识你时好多少。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp5
: In fact, things are probably worse now, aren’t they? What with you barely able to communicate with your supposed god and all.
lines.zh: : 事实上，现在的状况大概更糟了吧？你连跟你那位所谓的神沟通都快做不到了。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp6
: I have not been abandoned if that is what you are alluding to...we’ve merely found ourselves in a rather unprecedented situation as of late.
lines.zh: : 我没有被遗弃——如果你是在暗示这个的话……我们只是最近陷入了一个相当前所未有的局面。

lines.en: : There are limits to my knowledge, just as there are limits to yours. But my knowledge extends beyond the reach of man and yours struggles to even encircle you.
lines.zh: : 我的知识有界限，正如你的知识也有界限。但我的知识延伸到人手够不着的地方，而你的知识连你自己都围不住。

lines.en: : Yes, yes. The two of you have your differences in beliefs, but there is no need to get up in arms about them. This is precisely how wars begin.
lines.zh: : 是是是。你们俩信仰上有分歧，但没必要为此大动干戈。战争就是这么打起来的。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to “go to war” with Yasu. I’m just saying that I’d like a break from the fanaticism for a moment so I can walk home without feeling like I’m part of a cult.
lines.zh: : 我不是想跟 Yasu「开战」。我只是想让我清静一会儿，别再被狂热包围，好让我走回家时不觉得自己是某个邪教的一分子。

lines.en: : And I’m saying that you’d be far from alone even if you left us right now...
lines.zh: : 而我要说的是——就算你现在离开我们，你也绝不孤单……

lines.en: : You must be wary of the dark, for you never know what it carries. And the new skin you seek will not be found within its abyss until the cracks in your armor have been repaired. For that you must-
lines.zh: : 你必须提防黑暗，因为你永远不知道它带着什么。而你要寻的那张新皮，在你铠甲上的裂缝修补好之前，不会在它的深渊里出现。为此你必须——

lines.en: : Let me guess. Pray?
lines.zh: : 让我猜猜。祈祷？

lines.en: : Swim.
lines.zh: : 游泳。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp7
: Swim?...

: Through the rivers of the fifth heaven toward a brand new you — one detached from the weights in your head that bind your thoughts — who would kill their firstborn sons for the mere chance to drown you in sin.
lines.zh: : 游过第五重天的河流，去往一个全新的你——一个挣脱了你脑子里那些捆住思绪的配重的你——那些配重为了能把你们溺死在罪里，会杀掉自己的长子。

lines.en: : I thought heaven wasn’t real? That there was just some other plane or something?
lines.zh: : 我以为天堂不是真的？只有什么别的位面之类的？

lines.en: : It’s just a name, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想，那只是个名字罢了。

lines.en: : Like Yasu...
lines.zh: : 就像 Yasu……

lines.en: : Or Akira...
lines.zh: : 或者 Akira……

lines.en: : But what it’s called matters less than what it stands for and why its emerald waters can mend all the bones that you have broken.
lines.zh: : 但它叫什么，远不如它代表什么、以及为什么它碧绿的水能修补你折断的所有骨头来得重要。

lines.en: : At the risk of sounding even more like a sad sack of shit than I’ve sounded ever since quitting my job-
lines.zh: : 冒着比我辞掉工作以来听上去更像一坨悲惨的屎的风险——

lines.en: : You haven’t quit. You are merely taking an...extended vacation.
lines.zh: : 你没辞职。你只是请了一个……长假。

lines.en: : Says you. But at the risk of sounding any sadder, there is no amount of “emerald water” that can mend all that I’ve broken.
lines.zh: : 你是这么说。不过冒着听起来更惨的风险——再多的「碧绿之水」，也修补不了我弄坏的一切。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp8
: Which is why you must drag what you have destroyed into the water.
lines.zh: : 所以你才必须把你毁掉的东西拖进水里。

lines.en: scene apictureoftheocean
: You have broken bones outside of your body...dirtied the insides of countless whores and heathens. But there is nothing in this world that can not be fixed so long as He is the one who wills it.
lines.zh: : 你弄断了身体之外的骨头……弄脏了无数娼妓与异教徒的内里。但这世上没有什么是修不好的，只要祂愿意。

lines.en: : Take them and drown them. Hold their heads beneath the water and watch as they are healed. Fix them, for you are the reason they have broken. And you are the reason they continue to suffer.
lines.zh: : 带上他们，把他们淹进水里。按住他们的头，看着他们被治好。修好他们，因为你就是他们坏掉的原因。也是他们继续受苦的原因。

lines.en: : Yasu! You are being very impolite today!
lines.zh: : Yasu！你今天非常没礼貌！

lines.en: : She’s right this time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这次她没说错。

lines.en: : And you are being just as miserable as always.
lines.zh: : 而你也一如既往地消沉。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp9
: And I apologize for that. But I’ll take the status quo over evangelism any day of the week.
lines.zh: : 这一点我道歉。但一周七天里任何一天，我都宁可选现状，也不要布道。

lines.en: : If brutal honesty aimed at the terrible things I’ve done to girls like you two is what I have to deal with to avoid that, so be it. Chances are I’ve heard it all before already anyway.
lines.zh: : 如果为了躲开布道，我得面对这种针对我对你们这样的女孩做过的烂事的残酷实话，那就来吧。反正这些话我大概早就全听过了。

lines.en: : Yet here you are — dry — when there are so many bodies waiting for you to get them wet.
lines.zh: : 可你还在这里——干干的——而有那么多具身体正等着你把它们弄湿。

lines.en: : Wha- Yasu?!
lines.zh: : 什——Yasu？！

lines.en: : I understand why you won’t swim now.
lines.zh: : 我现在明白你为什么不游了。

lines.en: : You can’t.
lines.zh: : 你游不了。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp11
: Would you believe me if I told you I can and am just electing to abstain so as to not risk anyone else never making it back to land?
lines.zh: : 要是我告诉你，我游得了，只是选择不做，以免冒别人再也回不到岸上的险，你信吗？

lines.en: : I won’t, but He might. And His thoughts are the ones that matter.
lines.zh: : 我不信，但祂或许信。而祂的想法才是重要的。

lines.en: : So tell us, Akira — to what end will you shield those who defy protection?
lines.zh: : 那么告诉我们，Akira——你要护着那些拒绝被保护的人，到底护到什么地步？

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp9
: I don’t have an answer to that question.
lines.zh: : 这个问题我答不上来。

lines.en: : Because you can’t tell the difference between what you hold close and what you scorn?
lines.zh: : 是因为你分不清自己紧紧抓住的是什么、鄙弃的是什么吗？

lines.en: : Because no matter how hard I try to push everyone away, I can’t shake the fear that I would stop existing without them.
lines.zh: : 是因为不管我多用力把所有人推开，我都甩不掉那种恐惧——没有他们，我就不存在了。

lines.en: : Tell us what you mean.
lines.zh: : 说说你的意思。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp10
: I’m not sure how to get into it without adding fuel to the fire and sounding preachy myself, but I’ll do my best.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么开口才不至于火上浇油、让自己也变得说教，但我尽力。

lines.en: : There’s a part of me that believes everything is connected.
lines.zh: : 我身上有一部分相信，万事万物都是相连的。

lines.en: : Several important people scattered throughout my life have told me that. And my time here has done nothing but reaffirm it.
lines.zh: : 我生命中散落着的几个重要的人都这么跟我说过。而我在这儿的日子，只是不断印证了这一点。

lines.en: : I think this is both good and bad. It’s bad because anything connected to me is bound to short-circuit sooner or later///but it’s good because it means I won’t be alone even when I have to be or should be.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这既是好事也是坏事。坏是因为任何跟我相连的东西迟早都会短路///但好是因为它意味着，即使我不得不孤独、或者本该孤独的时候，我也不会是孤单一人。

lines.en: : These connections are all that we have. And like Floral Laura, I am a gardener. I must play my part to nurture and develop everyone (connections) because that is how I will complete Lessons in Love.
lines.zh: : 这些联结就是我们仅有的一切。而就像 Floral Laura 一样，我是个园丁。我必须尽我的本分去滋养、培育每一个人（联结），因为这就是我完成 Lessons in Love 的方式。

lines.en: : You believe that in order to find happiness, you must teach such a trait to everyone else?
lines.zh: : 你相信，为了找到幸福，你必须把这种特质教给其他所有人？

lines.en: : It’s not that simple. And I’m glad it’s not that simple because I think there are some people out there who will never be happy no matter what you teach them.
lines.zh: : 没那么简单。我很高兴它没那么简单，因为我觉得有些人不管你教他们什么，都永远不会幸福。

lines.en: : Happiness, based on my extremely limited experience (none), is a thing that someone must find on their own.
lines.zh: : 幸福，根据我极其有限的经验（零），是一个人必须自己去找的东西。

lines.en: : But just because I have abandoned this idea to a certain extent doesn’t mean I don’t acknowledge the importance of a watering can.
lines.zh: : 但我在某种程度上放弃了这想法，不代表我不承认洒水壶的重要性。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp11
: If these connections are all that we have, which I believe they are, then the best course of action would be to strengthen them, not sever them.
lines.zh: : 如果这些联结就是我们仅有的一切——我相信是的——那么最好的做法就是加固它们，而不是切断它们。

lines.en: : Each unit that disappears will be one more gap in information exchanged. And I am not the type of machine who can function once you start removing its parts.
lines.zh: : 每消失一个单元，就会多出一道信息交换上的缺口。而我不是那种拆了零件还能运转的机器。

lines.en: : What type of machine are you, Boy?
lines.zh: : 那你是什么样的机器，男孩？

lines.en: : Something between a dental drill and a massage chair — the second son of liquid teeth and a purveyor of the finest cotton swabs you ever did see.
lines.zh: : 介于牙钻和按摩椅之间的某种东西——液态牙齿的次子，以及你所见过的最上等的棉签的供应商。

lines.en: : Will you take these things with you to the next place?
lines.zh: : 你会把这些东西带到下一个地方去吗？

lines.en: : There is no next place. Kumon-mi is all we have.
lines.zh: : 没有下一个地方。Kumon-mi 就是我们仅有的一切。

lines.en: scene yasubenchlamp9
: Which is why I must protect its pieces.
lines.zh: : 所以我必须保护它的碎片。

lines.en: : I am a Collector.
lines.zh: : 我是一个收藏家。

lines.en: : I have no use for shattered mementos.
lines.zh: : 破碎的纪念品对我没有用处。

lines.en: scene nightsky
Maybe I’m right.
lines.zh: 也许我是对的。

lines.en: Maybe the key that will unlock the next act in my story isn’t one that can be forged from precious metals — but one that I must pluck from the inside of a body.
lines.zh: 也许能打开我故事下一幕的那把钥匙，不是用贵金属能锻造出来的——而是我必须从一具身体内部取出来的。

lines.en: There are so many special people in my life, and all of them want to be closer to me. So who am I to sit idly by and twiddle my thumbs while the me inside their heads beds them while they dream?
lines.zh: 我生命里有那么多特别的人，她们都想离我更近。那么，当她们脑海里的那个我在她们梦中与她们同床时，我凭什么袖手旁观、无所事事？

lines.en: Inaction is not protection. And even if this machine doesn’t function the way it used to, it still has some juice (cum) left in it.
lines.zh: 不作为不是保护。就算这台机器不如从前好使，它里面也还剩点汁液（精液）。

lines.en: Is this what they call SEEING THE LIGHT?
lines.zh: 这就是所谓的「看见光」吗？

lines.en: Is all it took a little time and a little prodding? Does this mean I can prod others? Can I jump the gun and dodge its bullets, throwing someone else in their path to form a new hole if I won’t fit into the original?
lines.zh: 只需要一点时间、一点推搡？这是不是意味着我也可以去推别人？我能不能抢先一步躲开它的子弹，把别人扔到弹道上去，好在我塞不进原来那个洞的时候，开一个新的？

lines.en: scene thething
yo.
lines.zh: 哟。

lines.en: : Yo.
those girls left.
lines.zh: 那些姑娘走了。

lines.en: : I kind of figured as much once that whale showed up.
lines.zh: : 那头鲸一出现，我就差不多猜到了。

lines.en: and you kept on trucking with the monologue despite that? humans are weird.
lines.zh: 就这样你还继续念你的独白？人类真奇怪。

lines.en: : We all have our quirks, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 我想，谁都有自己的怪癖吧。

lines.en: so, what does all of this mean?
lines.zh: 那么，这一切是什么意思？

lines.en: are you going to start adding to your collection after all?
lines.zh: 你终究还是打算给你的收藏添点东西了？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: why don’t you know?
lines.zh: 为什么不知道？

lines.en: : Because there’s some part of me that makes me hesitate when I want to do something bad.
lines.zh: : 因为我身上有某部分，在我想做坏事时会让我犹豫。

lines.en: that’s just you being a coward, akira.
lines.zh: 那就是你怂，akira。

lines.en: how many times has such an infantile worm of a thought snuck its way into your head only to be swallowed by something larger the second time your bodies touch?
lines.zh: 这种婴儿般蠕虫一样的念头，钻进你脑子里多少次了，可每次你们的身体第二次相碰时，它就被某个更大的东西吞掉了？

lines.en: it’s only bad the first time. after that, it’s habit.
lines.zh: 只有第一次是坏的。之后就是习惯。

lines.en: besides, what better way to strengthen your bond with someone than by fucking them until your little tadpoles start to hatch in their bodies?
lines.zh: 再说了，有什么比把他们操到你的小蝌蚪在他们体内孵化出来，更能加固你跟一个人的纽带？

lines.en: : I still don’t understand why you care in the first place. Can’t you just do this to someone else?
lines.zh: : 我还是不明白你到底为什么在乎。你不能去找别人干这个吗？

lines.en: maybe i’ve imprinted?
lines.zh: 也许我印刻了？

lines.en: you like bird metaphors, don’t you?
lines.zh: 你喜欢鸟的比喻，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t like birds anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不再喜欢鸟了。

lines.en: is it because your favorite one flew away?
lines.zh: 是因为你最喜欢的那只飞走了？

lines.en: : My fingers hurt from opening the cages.
lines.zh: : 开笼子开得我手指疼。

lines.en: on that note — that yasu is one dove of a fuckhole, huh?
lines.zh: 说到这个——那个 yasu 真是个鸽子似的骚洞，嗯？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: why not give her the light and “strengthen your bond?”
lines.zh: 为什么不把光给她，「加固你们的纽带」？

lines.en: she’ll like you more with tadpoles inside of her.
lines.zh: 体内有了蝌蚪，她会更喜欢你。

lines.en: she’ll probably never leave you after that.
lines.zh: 那样她大概就永远不会离开你了。

lines.en: : I don’t think it works that way.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不是这么运作的。

lines.en: you don’t think at all. you just try to. your mind is too small and worthless to actually do anything.
lines.zh: 你根本不会思考，你只是试着思考。你的脑子又小又没用，什么都干不成。

lines.en: : Yet it’s the mind you can’t help but plague.
lines.zh: : 可偏偏就是这颗脑子，你忍不住要来纠缠。

lines.en: you just have a knack for both ends of manipulation.
lines.zh: 你就是对操纵的两端都很有天分。

lines.en: if you were stronger, we never would have met.
: Then maybe I do need to start relying on others after all.
lines.zh: : 那也许我终究还是得开始依赖别人了。

lines.en: just think of how indestructible you would be if you had nothing left to hide. no more weaknesses or wounds.
lines.zh: 想想看，要是你再没有需要藏的东西，你会变得多坚不可摧。再没有弱点，再没有伤口。

lines.en: if the world accepted you for who you are — if you grew to accept yourself — this would all come to an end, would it not?
: Nothing will end until she’s back where she’s meant to be.
lines.zh: : 在她回到她该在的地方之前，什么都不会结束。

lines.zh: 也许她根本从来就不该在这里

I collapse into bed, unsure of what I have and haven’t done today.
lines.zh: 我瘫倒在床上，搞不清今天哪些事做了、哪些没做。

lines.en: There’s a flier in my pocket and a stray white hair on one of my sleeves.
lines.zh: 口袋里有张传单，袖子上有一根不知哪来的白头发。

lines.en: This brain is surely defective.
lines.zh: 这颗脑子一定是坏的。

lines.en: I should stop using it to think.
lines.zh: 我该别再用它思考了。
